name: Hokuei (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hokuei town emblem in green, navy and orange: a green and navy ring enclosing an orange stylised bird.
history: Municipal flag of Hokuei, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Hokuei town emblem — a green and navy ring enclosing an orange stylised bird
